name: Farmer's Companion
notes: v1.0.13: Fixed for Raft 1.1.01. F1 opens the menu again, and auto water, harvest, replant, growth boost and livestock collection run again (the whole mod was shutting itself down a few seconds after launch). The settings menu's buttons and tabs respond to clicks again (the menu was being drawn underneath the game's own UI, which swallowed every click).
